Vessel struck by projectile in Strait of Hormuz, crew casualty reported

A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, resulting in a crew casualty and damage to the engine room. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported the incident. Authorities are investigating the event, which caused no reported environmental impact. The incident occurred amid rising regional tensions.
